Friday just got a new name to know: FREAKETONAS. 🔥🍑
A brand new weekly ritual lands at Azucar, and this week DJ Ralphy-Ray is running the decks all night — perreo that won't let your hips sit still, dembow that hits chest-first, house that keeps building, and Latin hits woven through like it's nothing. 🎧
This is vibras latinas on a whole other level — the kind of night where la pista fills up and doesn't empty till close. No gimmicks, no filler, just a DJ who knows exactly how to read a crowd and keep it moving all night long. 💃🕺
Mark it, save it, tell your people — Freaketonas is about to be the Friday everybody circles on the calendar. This is only the beginning. 🌟

🗓️ Friday, November 6 | 9PM – Close
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💸 No Cover
🔞 21+
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #Freaketonas #VibrasLatinas #PascoNightlife #DjRalphyRay #LatinNight #PerreoNight

Now let's talk about what's in the cup. 🍹✨
Freaketonas isn't just about the music — it's a whole flavor experience. We're talking Mexican candy cocktails that taste like your childhood dulces got a glow-up, tequila cocktails made for sipping slow (or not so slow 👀), and the spiked horchata everybody's already obsessed with. Creamy, cinnamon, dangerous. 🥥🌶️
Pair that with DJ Ralphy-Ray keeping perreo, dembow, and house rolling all night, and you've got zero reasons to stay home this Friday. ZERO. 🙅‍♀️
And the best part? No cover. All night. So that extra round? Yeah, get it. 💅
This is Azucar's new Friday obsession — come find out why everyone's already talking about the horchata. 🫢

Pull up Pasco, this is the Friday everybody's gonna be talking about tomorrow. 🙌
